items.problem: A UWP app that keeps an in-process WinRT background task (windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint, e.g. DeviceUseTrigger) migrates to a manifest that builds cleanly but fails AppX registration at launch with 0x80080204 because the task class is not registered under windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer.
items.evidence: session-log.txt TURN 47 Test-AppLaunch: '0x80080204 ... not allowed to have EntryPoint="BackgroundTask.Scenario1_BackgroundTask" without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer'; TURN 48 the agent added the inProcessServer Extension.
items.root_cause: UWP registered the in-process background-task class implicitly; a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app must register it as an in-process COM server. Neither the Background Tasks pattern, the Manifest checklist, nor Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 covered this, and a clean dotnet build never surfaces it.
items.change: Added static check 5c to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: for every non-audio windows.backgroundTasks Extension, FAIL if its EntryPoint has no matching ActivatableClassId under a windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer Extension, with a fix-it message.
items.expected_effect: The missing registration is flagged during Validate-UwpMigration (before launch) instead of surfacing only as a raw 0x80080204 AppX error, so the agent fixes it deterministically.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, Validate-UwpMigration prints '[FAIL] ... windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint=... with no matching windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer registration' when the extension is missing, and '[PASS] ... in-process background task(s) registered' once added; Test-AppLaunch no longer hits 0x80080204.

items.problem: The Background Tasks migration guidance only steers toward replacing IBackgroundTask (BackgroundTaskBuilder / push activation) and gives no path for triggers that must stay in-process, nor the manifest registration they require.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Background Tasks was a single sentence; grep for 'activatableClass'/'inProcessServer' returned nothing across the skill.
items.root_cause: Absent documentation for the 'retain in-process WinRT task' path and its packaging requirement.
items.change: Expanded the Background Tasks anchor to name the in-process-only triggers (DeviceUseTrigger/DeviceServicingTrigger) and cross-link a new item 5 in the Manifest migration checklist that documents the windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer requirement, the 0x80080204 symptom, the exact XML, and the audio-task exemption.
items.expected_effect: When the agent retains an in-process task, it adds the inProcessServer registration from the doc instead of discovering it via a runtime failure.
items.falsifiable_check: A re-run agent that reads the Background Tasks / Manifest checklist adds the inProcessServer Extension before first launch (no 0x80080204 recovery turn in the log).
